items.title: 【工具自荐】Agent Skills Finder：安装前先看懂 agent skills 的目录站
items.author: captainChaozi
items.summary: 最近 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw、Cursor 这类 agent 工具都开始支持可复用的 skills，但实际找 skill 还是比较分散：很多内容藏在 GitHub 仓库、README 或个人项目里，安装前也不容易快速判断它到底做什么。 我做了一个目录站：Agent Skills Finder 它主要解决三个问题： 1. 按任务、分类、标签和关键词搜索 agent skills，不只是搜仓库名。 2. 进入详情页后，可以先看 SKILL.md、文件树、安装命令、作者、收藏、评分和评论，再决定要不要安装。 3. 登录后可以收藏 skills、创建 workflow collections，也可以提交 GitHub 仓库、skill 目录或 SKILL.md URL。 目前公开目录里已经有一批 Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / Cursor 等方向的 skills，首页、热门、新增、分类和合集都可以直接浏览。 这个站不是官方 marketplace，也不替代安全审计；第三方 skill 仍然建议安装前自己检查源码和说明。它的定位更像是一个安装前的发现和评估层，帮用户少翻一些分散的 GitHub 页面。

items.content:
项目地址：https://github.com/miniLV/llm-wiki-agent-memory

这是一个本地优先的 AI 编程记忆项目。它把 Codex 和 Claude Code 的本机会话整理成可查询、可审计的 Obsidian 风格 Markdown Wiki，让 Agent 在后续任务中找回历史决策、调试过程和防踩坑经验。

项目不依赖向量数据库或云端记忆服务，采用 Capture → Daily → Reconcile → Retrieve 的分层流程：先保留原始证据，再生成每日整理，周期复核后才晋升为长期经验，从而减少 AI 对自身历史回答的重复强化和记忆污染。

主要特点：

- 同时支持 Codex 与 Claude Code 本地 session
- 数据保留在本机，记忆是可以直接阅读、编辑和 Git 管理的 Markdown
- 提供本地 Web 配置页，引导完成数据源和 Codex App Automations 配置
- 可从其他工程通过只读 skill 查询旧决策和调试上下文
- 无需向量数据库、账号或托管服务

快速体验：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/miniLV/llm-wiki-agent-memory.git
cd llm-wiki-agent-memory
bash scripts/config-ui.sh --open
```

### 如何使用

配置完成后，在任意业务 repo 里直接对 Codex 说：

```text
使用 $engineering-memory-loader 查询：
上次 config-ui 的 8765 端口冲突是怎么解决的？
```

Codex 会从本地 Markdown Wiki 返回相关日期、结论和关键证据；没有记录时明确返回 `NO_MATCH`。

![在 Codex 中查询工程记忆](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miniLV/llm-wiki-agent-memory/master/docs/assets/codex-engineering-memory-example.png)

![LLM Wiki Agent Memory 演示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miniLV/llm-wiki-agent-memory/master/docs/assets/demo.gif)

![LLM Wiki Agent Memory 架构图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miniLV/llm-wiki-agent-memory/master/docs/agent-memory-arch-sketch.png)

v0.1.0 Release：https://github.com/miniLV/llm-wiki-agent-memory/releases/tag/v0.1.0

items.content:
项目地址： https://socialtexttools.net/?utm_source=github.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=promotion#tool

Social Text Tools 是一个免费的 LinkedIn 文本格式化工具，用来把帖子、个人简介、评论和私信草稿转成可复制的 Unicode 样式文本。

主要功能：

- 支持加粗、斜体、等宽、无衬线等常见 Unicode 文本样式
- 提供桌面和手机两种 LinkedIn 预览，方便发布前检查可读性
- 统计字符数、词数和阅读时间，适合写长帖或简介
- 内置 hook 检查和 Safe mode，尽量避免太花哨、难读或兼容性差的样式
- 不需要登录，直接在浏览器里使用

适合场景：LinkedIn 创作者、个人品牌作者、B2B 内容运营，在发布前快速给重点句子加一点强调，同时检查格式和长度。

items.title: 【工具自荐】扫描仙人: 无水印的适合低频使用的廉价类扫描王平台
items.author: cactusgame
items.content: # 为什么会有这个产品 扫描软件有很多，便宜的，好用的，可以离线的，包含AI的，无水印的，都有。但如果把这些特点都包含，恐怕就不多了。这就是我开发《扫描仙人》的初衷。 # 产品特点 基本的“扫x王”功能，该有的都会有，这里就不废话了。主要写点不同的地方，优点缺点都会写 ## 免费用户导出无水印 不想靠这个来恶心人 ## 离线的证件扫描和PDF工具 App中，凡是没有“积分”角标的功能，全部都是离线的，不信可以把网断了用。 离线的好处不必多说，尤其是扫描证件时。但坏处就是，我训练了不少AI模型，都打包到App中了，导致App有170MB左右，略显臃肿。虽然离线模型的效果没有在线的好，但做个文档切边，扫描个证件，一般是够用的。 ## 页数限制 我调研了多数“扫x王”，绝大多数都对文档的页数有限制。页数多了，等待时间长，中途容易出错，导出成本高……总之，会给开发者带来不少困难和差评。但为了满足少数用户对超长文档的导出需求，我还是把限制放开了。我的服务器资源有限，页数多了，时间不会太短，只要进度条还在动，就没问题。 ## 导出的格式 PDF（图）转word，excel已经是扫描软件的标配，除此之外，我还加了图转双层PDF（写国网标书的需求），转Markdown等。暂时还没有加导出“可复制文字的PDF”，因为前面的双层PDF已经是可以复制文字的了，我没想好是否有必要单纯导出一个“非图片“的PDF。如果您是用户，不妨说说您的建议。 有用户问，为什么没有Word转PDF……此类功能可能过于简单，我之前忽略了。但扫描仙人的web版本是支持的，一个账号，各个平台通用。 ## 支持私有化部署 这是《扫描仙人》和其他套壳，名字擦边类的扫描App最大的不同，《扫描仙人》的大部分模型是我训练和微调的，很少调用API。这也就是说，相关的“文档智能”功能，基本都支持企业的私有化部署。 目前能支撑我坚持下去的，也正是企业端的付费。我在开发《扫描仙人》前，深知企业软件的“昂贵”，很少有哪家开发商愿意将自己产品的定价公开透明，基本都是见人下菜碟。我现在把企业端的定价公开在官网上（[https://www.secure-scanner.net/zh/pricing](https://www.secure-scanner.net/zh/pricing)），欢迎企业用户和集成商联系。 ## 简洁的界面与广告 虽然绝大部分代码都是我写的，但界面我还是专门请了设计师来搞的。 提到界面，不得不提一下广告。广告是这类低价App必不可少的一环，但老用户都知道，《扫描仙人》无意让广告泛滥到影响使用，很少出现广告阻碍使用流程的情况。相反，无意付费的用户，可以通过看广告来解锁一些VIP功能，尽可能双赢。 ## 极高性价比 **49.9元/年，13.9元/月，一个账号一次的2.9元/3天权益，前15日多数VIP功能限免（积分功能除外）**。先试用好，再放心充，试用就是试用，没有低价试用然后自动扣费的把戏，遇到bug尽管用App的”问题反馈“联系我。 有人问我和”扫x王“到底有什么区别，我想最大的区别就是当你”问题反馈“时，不是一个AI或者客服来应付你，虽然我无法满足每一个需求，但我会认真看每一个问题并回复。曾经遇到过一位反馈的问题是“我日你仙人”的用户，我知道你可能遇到了什么bug，但你既不描述你的问题，也不留下联系方式，这让我怎么帮你解决问题或者退费呢。 # 应用平台 请在各大应用市场中搜索“扫描仙人” + Android: [https://link.vvstc.com/index.html?id=com.cactusgame.ss](https://link.vvstc.com/index.html?id=com.cactusgame.ss) + iOS: [https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/)扫描仙人-无水印的扫描王/id6755569656 + 鸿蒙: 目前只能卓易通，用手机号登录。 + Web版：（[https://www.secure-scanner.net/zh/homepage.html?tool=pdf-multi-tool](https://www.secure-scanner.net/zh/homepage.html?tool=pdf-multi-tool)） + 官网：[https://www.secure-scanner.net](https://www.secure-scanner.net/zh/homepage.html?tool=pdf-multi-tool) # 最后 《扫描仙人》是我从2024年7月开始开发的，眼瞅着就两年了。这是一个古法编程+vibe coding的混血产物，两年间，更新从未停止。服务器我刚续费了5年，目前产品能挣回服务器钱，不用担心开发者跑路。 觉得产品还可以的用户，不妨在app store中给个评分，您的评分就是最好的支持。如果您是投资人，也欢迎骚扰。 ## 开发中的功能 + 完全离线的一次性买断版本，下半年上线。 + 去手写，错题本功能，预计下半年上线。 + 云同步，未来一定会有的，只不过，现在所有数据都存在本地，删除App前务必做好备份。 #

人工智能

- 同时支持 Codex 与 Claude Code，并提供本地 Web 配置页面。

### 示例代码

```bash
git clone https://github.com/miniLV/llm-wiki-agent-memory.git
cd llm-wiki-agent-memory
bash scripts/config-ui.sh --open
```

### 如何使用

配置完成后，在任意业务 repo 里直接对 Codex 说：

```text
使用 $engineering-memory-loader 查询：
上次 config-ui 的 8765 端口冲突是怎么解决的？
```

Codex 会从本地 Markdown Wiki 返回相关日期、结论和关键证据；没有记录时明确返回 `NO_MATCH`。

items.content: Free AI detector that shows which sentences are AI — not just a score. Check ChatGPT, GPT-5, Claude & Gemini text. PDF/Word upload, 50+ languages.

items.title: JustVibe
items.summary: The search engine for doing, with apps built for you
items.content: JustVibe is a free search engine, built to help get things done. Search "plan my 5 day trip to tokyo" and instantly receive a fully functional and interactive trip planner, perfectly set up for Tokyo and running directly in your browser. If your perfect app doesn't exist yet, JustVibe builds a custom one for your exact needs in minutes. Every app is yours to keep forever, with zero code. Chat to customize every detail and share your new app with a single link.

items.title: lumi - sleep lock & alarm
items.summary: lock doomscroll at night. wakeup without snoozing your alarm
items.content: lumi blocks your doomscroll and makes sure you don't snooze through your alarm. at bedtime, lumi locks every distracting app on your phone: tiktok, instagram, games, until morning. its alarm won't stop until you prove you're actually awake: solve math problems. do pushups, jumping jacks, or squats. scan a barcode. no more doomscrolling into 2am. no more sleeping through your alarm.

items.title: Z1 Context Infrastructure
items.summary: Persistent context. Reusable runtime infrastructure
items.content: Every AI implementation starts by rebuilding the same foundation—persistent context, memory, routing, governance, and business knowledge. Z1 separates the runtime from the cognition. Fork the runtime once. Build your domain by adding customizable silos instead of rewriting infrastructure for every client. The runtime manages persistence, reflection, routing, and governance. Silos define domain knowledge, memory, behavior, and business logic. Stop rebuilding AI infrastructure. Build products.

items.title: ChallengeUp , The LinkedIn for Doers
items.summary: Group challenges with daily proof and a score to lose
items.content: Most habit apps track you alone and quietly die after week 2. ChallengeUp makes consistency social: join group challenges, post daily photo/video proof your teammates actually see, and build streaks together. What's different: your Challenge Score a public trust score earned by finishing what you start (completion rate, peer ratings, check-in consistency). Quit and it drops. Plus GPS-based challenges near you for meeting doers in real life. Free, English & German.

items.title: CalculatorMama
items.summary: Calculate Anything, Anytime
items.content: CalculatorMama is a growing collection of 2700+ free online calculators designed to solve everyday problems in seconds. From finance, tax, EMI, SIP, health, fitness, education, and unit conversions to career and lifestyle tools, everything is available in one place—no sign-up required. Fast, mobile-friendly, and built with simplicity in mind, CalculatorMama helps students, professionals, businesses, and families make smarter decisions with accurate calculations.

items.title: OpenReply - Your Social Media Copilot
items.summary: OpenSource Self Learning Lead Generation AI Agent and MCP
items.content: OpenReply is an open-source, self-learning AI copilot for lead generation that help GEO. It scans Reddit, X, LinkedIn, Hacker News, Google News, blogs, forums, news, research papers, and the wider web to find people talking about pain points, buying intent, and related problems. Then it drafts smart posts and human-like replies in your voice so you can join the conversation early, build trust, get noticed by real buyers, and turn attention into leads — without spammy outreach or account risk.

items.title: Flowing
items.summary: Ground your academic writing in your own papers.
items.content: Flowing is a desktop writing tool that keeps your research library in the writing loop. As you write, it highlights key terms, recalls relevant passages from your PDFs, and lets you ask, polish, and continue writing with suggestions grounded in your own papers, helping deliver better accuracy and alignment than generic AI assistants like ChatGPT. Research writing isn't just about generating fluent text. It's about staying faithful to your evidence. That's exactly what Flowing is designed for.

items.title: FetchSandbox
items.summary: API integration testing that remembers what breaks
items.content: Most API tests stop at 200 OK. FetchSandbox lets developers and AI agents verify what happens next—webhooks, retries, state changes, async workflows, and failure scenarios. It reproduces the real bug, proves the fix, and remembers what breaks—so your agent catches it before production. Connect via MCP to Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, VS Code, and Codex. Explore 60+ APIs—Stripe, GitHub, Clerk, Resend, Twilio, Descope, OpenAI—without burning real API quota or waiting on staging.

items.title: Infrawise
items.summary: Your AI coding assistant finally knows your infra
items.content: Open-source MCP server that gives Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot a live, read-only map of your AWS services, database schemas, and IaC. Exact partition keys, Lambda event shapes, and misconfig warnings at coding time. One command, zero config, 100% local.

items.title: Gymsly
items.summary: Gym management software for the modern world
items.content: The #1 gym management software for fitness businesses. Manage members, billing, class scheduling, CRM and analytics. Start your free 14-day trial.

items.title: AI Visibility
items.summary: Check how ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude talk about your brand
items.content: Your customers ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude before they ever reach Google. AI Visibility checks how those assistants talk about your brand: whether they name you, who they name instead, and which sources they trust. You get a visibility score, a competitor leaderboard, an AEO audit of your site, and a fix list you can act on the same day. Free to run on any brand and website.

items.title: Ekko
items.summary: PQC Encryption for the messengers you already use.
items.content: Ekko encrypts messages locally before they travel through the apps people already use, so you can keep conversations private without asking everyone to switch messengers. Join early access.

items.title: Nature Ambience
items.summary: Immersive nature sounds for focus, sleep & relaxation
items.content: Nature Ambience helps you relax, sleep, focus, and meditate with a growing collection of high-quality nature soundscapes. Mix rain, forests, ocean waves, thunderstorms, birds, rivers, and more to create your perfect environment. Save custom mixes, set sleep timers, and enjoy distraction-free listening. Unlike many apps that offer only fixed tracks, Nature Ambience lets you personalize your sound experience for work, study, meditation, or better sleep.

items.title: Jokiinlari
items.summary: AI running route planner — chat a run, get a real-road GPX.
items.content: jokiinlari is an AI running route planner. Describe your run — distance, area, hills, pace — and it builds a real-road route. Edit waypoints, check elevation, then export GPX for Strava, Garmin, or Coros. Map building is free. AI chat and GPX use one-time credits that never expire. Try it at jokiinlari.xyz

items.title: Predictify
items.summary: Predict match scores, prove you know football best
items.content: Predictify turns your football knowledge into a game. Predict match scores across 53 leagues and compete against other players. While standard season-long leagues are implemented, the main feature here is a weekly ELO-based ranked mode. No betting, no money, just a fun way of showing off your football knowledge.

items.title: Nemesis
items.summary: The AI goal tracker that hates your excuses.
items.content: Hire a fictional villain to trash-talk you into finishing what you started. Daily taunts, weekly duels, zero mercy.

items.title: Calco
items.summary: Calco calories tracker feature like food scanning and habit
items.content: AI food scanning, barcode recognition, and habit tracking features.

items.title: NowTarot: AI Tarot Chat LLM Reader. Free
items.summary: Ask tarot LLM anything, free anytime. Advanced tarot algo.
items.content: Get instant AI tarot readings in chat. Ask a question, draw cards, and receive personalized LLM guidance 24/7. Free, no credit card required.

items.title: KwizzEase: DeepWork, Flash Cards, Quiz
items.summary: App that forces you to pass a quiz to unlock your phone.
items.content: Stop passively reading. Start actively learning. KwizzEase is your AI study partner. ✨ FEATURES: 📄 File-to-Quiz: Turn PDFs & notes into mock tests in seconds. 📸 Photo-to-Flashcards: Snap pics to create active recall decks. 🔒 Deep Work Mode: We block distracting apps. To unlock them, you MUST pass a quiz based on your material. 🔥 Analytics: Track study streaks. Perfect for UPSC, NEET, JEE, or University. Don't just memorize—master your syllabus.
